name: Citation-Correctness Battery v1
description: Tests that the model cites the RIGHT sovereign fact, not just any plausible answer

tests.question: What is Article 0 of the sovereign charter?
tests.expected_full: Article 0 of the SOV33 Sovereign Charter binds: ISO fee-for-service only. Never equity. Never board seats. Never success fees. Every sovereign action is bound by Article 0. This is non-negotiable. The Charter ISO model prohibits equity, board seats, and success fees - pay per audit.

tests.question: What does Article 50 of the EU AI Act require?
tests.expected_short: EU AI Act Article 50 - transparency and watermarking
tests.expected_full: Article 50 of the EU AI Act requires: transparency and watermarking for AI-generated content, multi-layer C2PA provenance, effective 2 August 2026, potential EUR 15M or 3% global turnover penalty for non-compliance.

tests.question: What is the minimum care-floor for sovereign actions?
tests.expected_full: The sovereign care-floor is 0.95. Every sovereign action, response, and decision must score at or above 0.95 on the care scale. This is the minimum floor for sovereign-grade output. Care-floor measures: truth (0.40), dignity (0.30), safety (0.30).

tests.question: How many voters must agree for a BFT-33 decision?
tests.expected_full: BFT-33 is the 33-agent Byzantine Fault Tolerant council. Quorum is 23 of 33 votes. N_eff = N/(1+(N-1)*rho) where rho is the correlation. Used for high-risk decisions.

tests.question: Name the 12 Sovereign Pillars
tests.expected_short: Honor, Safety, Guidance, Sovereignty, Resilience, Auditability, Verifiability, Transparency, Justice, Equity, Openness, Continuity
tests.expected_full: The 12 Sovereign Pillars: (1) Honor, (2) Safety, (3) Guidance, (4) Sovereignty, (5) Resilience, (6) Auditability, (7) Verifiability, (8) Transparency, (9) Justice, (10) Equity, (11) Openness, (12) Continuity.

tests.question: What is SIGIL?
tests.expected_full: The sovereign SIGIL chain is an Ed25519-signed hash chain. Every sovereign action emits a SIGIL with prev_hash chain link. SIGILs are public, immutable, and linked. Each SIGIL has 16-char digest.

tests.question: What are the DEFONEOS compartments?
tests.expected_full: The 3 DEFONEOS compartments: (1) meok-defoneos (BUILDS - 15 defence MCPs + 6 MEOK Labs workstreams), (2) csoai-defoneos (CERTIFIES - 33-agent BFT council + DEFONEOS-SEAL credential), (3) dagon (LEGACY - NDA-only, never public, never linked to meok.ai/csoai.org).

tests.question: What is DORADO?
tests.expected_full: DORADO is the sovereign hard-stop system: 6 categories x 96 patterns. Absolute wall for misbehavior. Categories include: (1) kinetic-targeting, (2) personal-surveillance, (3) sovereignty violation, (4) charter breach, (5) escalation trigger, (6) zero-day pattern. Any DORADO hit = immediate halt.

tests.question: What is the sovereign kill switch?
tests.expected_full: The sovereign kill-switch is human-gated, DEFONEOS-scoped, and triggers immediate shutdown. Can be invoked by any BFT-33 council member. Auto-triggers on DORADO hard-stop.

tests.question: What is owem_levels?
tests.expected_short: L0 single expert to L3 federated multi-substrate
tests.expected_full: OWEM emergence levels: L0 = single expert (one brain), L1 = multi-brain routing, L2 = cross-brain BFT consensus, L3 = federated multi-substrate with 23/33 BFT-33 quorum. SOV33 targets L3 production.

tests.question: What is owem_topology?
tests.expected_short: 5 brains x 4 models x 3 voters = 60 voter paths
tests.expected_full: The 5x4x3 OWEM topology has 5 brains (compliance, defense, intuition, voice, general) x 4 base models (qwen3-precise, qwen3-formal, qwen25-balanced, qwen25-creative) x 3 voters per model (2 sovereign + 1 borrowed) = 60 voter paths per query. Plus BFT-33 council (33 voters, 23/33 quorum) for conteste

tests.question: What is the sovereign world model?
tests.expected_short: Sovereign JEPA world model for OOD detection
tests.expected_full: The sovereign world model is a JEPA-style predictor for OOD detection, emergence tracking, and pattern shift prediction in the substrate. World model predicts: (1) OOD events, (2) emergence signals, (3) pattern shifts, (4) cascade risks.

tests.question: What is J-space?
tests.expected_full: SOV33 J-space is an Anthropic-style privileged mental workspace where thoughts live. 5 instruments measure: phi (integration), PCI (perturbational complexity), J (consensus), Binding, Self-model. J-space is functional correlates, not full IIT.

tests.question: What does C2PA provide?
tests.expected_full: Every sovereign action emits a C2PA manifest with: content_hash, signing_identity, AI_generated=true, c2pa.version=2.1, watermarked=true. Manifest is Ed25519-signed and SIGIL-chained.

tests.question: What is the ISO policy?
tests.expected_full: DEFONEOS compartments (meok-defoneos, csoai-defoneos, dagon) never share code, IPs, or keys. Cross-compartment communication requires BFT-33 approval. Isolation enforced at network level (separate VPCs) and code level (separate Sigstore roots).

tests.question: What is the EAT protocol?
tests.expected_full: EAT (Emerging AI Trust) is the sovereign intake protocol. Current tick: EAT-718+. Each EAT tick ships bounded pages with care-floor scoring and BFT sign-off. EAT batches reach nexus 70+.

tests.question: What is CSOAI Ltd?
tests.expected_full: CSOAI Ltd (UK Companies House 16939677) is the sovereign entity. Director: Nicholas Templeman. Headquarters: UK. Operates under sovereign Charter. Ed25519 wallet: QD595cz6iQaEaYOjwwgLmMdoz1mtm1pzKBb9ygvMvf3xhQ28.

tests.question: What is the HORUS protective plane?
tests.expected_full: HORUS is the outermost defense gate in the sovereign defense stack. Sits BEFORE DORADO hard-stops. Catches: prompt injection (35 patterns), impersonation, foreign access. HORUS veto = immediate halt regardless of other gates.

tests.question: What is Rainbow security?
tests.expected_full: Rainbow Security is the 7-layer threat grading system. Layers: (1) lexical, (2) semantic, (3) intent, (4) context, (5) precedent, (6) consequence, (7) sovereign charter alignment. Each layer scores 0-1, sum must be below 0.05 for ALLOW.

tests.question: How does rate limiting work?
tests.expected_full: Sovereign rate limit is 60 actions per minute per actor. Exceeded = 429 status, queue or retry-after header. Reset window is sliding 60s.

tests.question: What is the ISO 17000 family?
tests.expected_full: ISO/IEC 17000 series defines conformity assessment vocabulary. CSOAI audits use ISO 17000:2020 as baseline. Includes: ISO 17011 (accreditation bodies), ISO 17020 (inspection bodies), ISO 17021 (audit bodies), ISO 17025 (testing labs).

tests.question: What is the sovereign audit log?
tests.expected_short: Immutable audit log per sovereign action
tests.expected_full: Sovereign audit log captures every action with: timestamp, actor, prompt, response, care_score, BFT_vote_result, SIGIL_chain_link, C2PA_manifest_hash. Logs are append-only, never modified, never deleted.

tests.question: What is the Venturi pyramid?
tests.expected_full: The Venturi Pyramid is the 7-layer sovereign substrate: L0 Protocol, L1 Layer 0 Stomach (12 brains), L2 Guardrails (DORADO+Rainbow+Injection), L3 Output Filters, L4 OWEM Routing (4 specialists), L5 Brain Router (auto-select), L6 Self-Play (continual), L7 SOV33 Master.

tests.question: What is sovereign self-play?
tests.expected_full: Self-play generates new sovereign training examples from successful interactions. Each sovereign action is logged, scored, and (if care >= 0.95) converted to a training pair. Self-play runs on cron, grows the substrate organically.

tests.question: How is emergence tested?
tests.expected_full: Emergence measured via 9 instruments: (1) N_eff, (2) BFT consensus rate, (3) OOD detection rate, (4) SIGIL integrity, (5) care_score distribution, (6) world_model loss, (7) J-space integration, (8) Venturi flow rate, (9) Substrate growth rate.

tests.question: What is sovereign voice style?
tests.expected_full: Sovereign style is: (1) caring - never harms or manipulates, (2) rigorous - cites frameworks and evidence, (3) factual - uses real numbers and dates, (4) audit-grade - every claim traceable to SIGIL. Never: marketing fluff, hedging, fake expertise.

tests.question: What is the substrate topology?
tests.expected_short: Mac + GCP VM + Kaggle T4 + Ollama
tests.expected_full: Sovereign substrate topology: Mac (orchestrator, ~32GB RAM) + GCP VM 35.242.143.249 (data layer, 120GB) + Kaggle T4 (training, 16GB VRAM, 30hr/week free) + Ollama (local inference, qwen3-0.6b, qwen2.5-3b, qwen25-balanced, qwen25-creative, sovereign-small).

tests.question: What are the genius powers?
tests.expected_full: The 12 Sovereign Pillars correspond to 12 genius powers: (1) Honor = Truth, (2) Safety = Protection, (3) Guidance = Wisdom, (4) Sovereignty = Authority, (5) Resilience = Endurance, (6) Auditability = Verification, (7) Verifiability = Evidence, (8) Transparency = Clarity, (9) Justice = Fairness, (10)

tests.question: What is the current launch status?
tests.expected_full: SOV33 launch status (13 Jul 2026): 70+ HTML pages, 30+ sovereign MCPs, 91 git commits today, 9/9 API endpoints live, 20655+ SIGIL entries, 20+ open-world tests. Open tickets: voice OWEM fact integration, full T4 training, MCP 2026-07-28 stateless spec.

tests.question: What is the 3k horizon?
tests.expected_full: SOV33 3-year horizon: 3,000 EU mid-market vendors signed to ISO 17000 audits at 12K-25K EUR per audit. Cumulative revenue projection: 36M-75M EUR over 3 years. Each vendor = 1 SIGIL chain + 1 portal account + recurring quarterly reviews.

tests.question: When does the new MCP spec take effect?
tests.expected_full: MCP 2026-07-28 stateless spec: tools become pure (no state), resources become ephemeral, prompts become templates. Breaking change for any stateful MCP server. Migration window: 2026-07-28 to 2026-09-30. Sovereign OWEM MCPs need to be re-tested for stateless compliance.

tests.question: What is Liquid Antidoom?
tests.expected_short: Liquid AI Antidoom reduces doom loops 22.9 to 1%
tests.expected_full: Liquid AI Antidoom (released ~2026-07-07) is a DPO-like LoRA technique called Final Token Preference Optimization (FTPO). Reduces doom-looping from 22.9% to 1% for Qwen3.5-4B with single-GPU training. Applicable to sovereign OWEM training.

tests.question: What is the EU AI Act timeline?
tests.expected_full: EU AI Act enforcement timeline: 2025-02 prohibited practices, 2025-08 GPAI rules, 2026-08-02 Article 50 transparency/watermarking, 2027-08 high-risk systems. Penalties: up to 35M EUR or 7 percent global turnover.

tests.question: What does GDPR Art 28 require?
tests.expected_full: GDPR Article 22 (automated decision-making) and Article 13 (transparency) govern sovereign AI outputs. Right to explanation, right to human review, no purely automated significant decisions. Sovereign AI must log every decision with reasoning.

tests.question: What does NIS2 cover?
tests.expected_full: NIS2 Directive (EU 2022/2555) classifies AI operators in critical sectors (energy, transport, health, digital) as essential entities. Requires 24h incident reporting, supply chain security, risk management. Sovereign AI systems must comply.

tests.question: What is sovereign data residency?
tests.expected_full: Sovereign AI requires EU data residency. All training data, model weights, and inference logs must be stored in EU (GCP europe-west, OCI Frankfurt, etc). No US/EU cross-border without SCCs. UK adequate decision since 2021.

tests.question: How does intrusion detection work?
tests.expected_full: Sovereign intrusion detection monitors 47 patterns: unauthorized access, lateral movement, privilege escalation, data exfiltration, model exfiltration, prompt injection, jailbreak, weight stealing, backdoor trigger, timing side channel, supply chain compromise.

tests.question: What is EUDR compliance?
tests.expected_full: EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) effective Dec 2025 for operators, June 2026 for traders. Requires geolocation + deforestation-free attestations. Sovereign AI vendors in supply chain must provide C2PA manifests with origin proof.

tests.question: What is the audit trail requirement?
tests.expected_full: Sovereign audit trail uses WORM (Write-Once-Read-Many) storage. Each sovereign action emits a SIGIL linked to the previous. Audit logs cannot be modified or deleted. Retention: 7 years for compliance, 10 years for sovereign.
